spec.prompt:
Refine this game logo (IMAGE1) for three precise user corrections. User points to the coin/note crop in IMAGE4 saying 这个形状不对优化一下; then specifically requests typography from IMAGE2 and 外圈边缘还是纸的质感. IMAGE3 is the game's actual Jiaozi bill design/vertical proportions.

A. TYPOGRAPHY: exact ONLY title 交子赶工记, top 交子 and bottom 赶工记. Redraw the title with the genuinely handmade Chinese ink-lettering character of IMAGE2. Study its varying brush pressure, irregular generous dots, thick/thin contrasts, short/long stroke rhythm, optical stagger and surprising but readable spacing. Avoid a generic standard calligraphy font, avoid evenly swollen rounded bold, avoid a conventional printed typeface made rough. Retain clear correct five characters; 赶=走+干 and 记=讠+己. Natural personal hand-lettered sign, playful confident traditional shop branding, warm near-black ink #302A26. A few sparse dry-brush breaks only where strokes turn or end, not a distressed texture filter. Do NOT reproduce any words or source seal lettering from IMAGE2; borrow the letter-craft, not its brand. Keep the title as flat ink on paper, not raised 3D individual letters.

B. CORRECT LEFT NOTE/COIN SHAPE: REMOVE the existing generic horizontal card with a blank square. Replace with ONE clearly VERTICAL RECTANGULAR JIAOZI BANKNOTE, approximate width:height 2:3, softly uneven thin paper edge, slight natural tilt only. Use IMAGE3's actual structure as a simplified small emblem: fine dark rectangular border, two short rows of coin circles at top, a small vertical 交子 title mark and sparse vertical printed columns, a minimal paper-workshop roof line near bottom, tiny muted red square seal. Enough large clear marks to identify Song paper currency, no dense tiny gibberish, no envelope, credit card, square hole in the banknote, or generic blank card. It is longer vertically than horizontally, plainly. Position upper-left next to title without covering any word.
Behind the upper part of the note put ONE bronze ROUND coin with a true centered SQUARE opening. Correct symmetry: circular outside edge, straight four equal sides of the square hole, front-facing or only very slightly tilted, consistent perspective; not an egg shape, diamond/rectangular hole or wobbly ring. Note and coin belong to the same shallow collage plane. Muted aged bronze, no glossy gold. Partly overlap coin by the vertical note, compact secondary ornament.

C. PAPER OUTER EDGE: change the current thick uniform smoothly bevelled beige badge perimeter into a THIN real XUAN-PAPER CUTOUT silhouette. This is paper, not cookie/foam/wood. Soft warm ivory backing follows the new title as one loose organic silhouette with quiet shallow curves, no cartoon cloud scallops repeated around every letter. Slight natural irregularity on cut/torn edge and a few short pale paper fibres visible close-up, not fuzzy bright halo. A tiny 1-2px warm shadow beneath demonstrates one or two thin paper sheets. REMOVE thick tan sidewalls, dark outlined rim, multiple offset gold/teal layers and plastic bevel. Fine paper fibre texture only on rim; broad face remains clean and pale, not aged dirty grain.
Retain one small simple ivory auspicious cloud at right and small cinnabar seal, drawn or cut as thin paper, unobtrusive. No additional icons or characters. Do not add colored perimeter bands.

Final output SQUARE 1:1 RGBA PNG on fully transparent outside background. The naturally wide logo is centered with ample transparent margins, no stretching/cropping. No cream rectangular canvas, fake checkerboard, black background, colored matte fringe, noise speckles or explanatory text. Hand-lettered typography is main focus, proper vertical Jiaozi and round-square coin second, subtle convincing paper-cut edge third. Keep calm ink/ivory/bronze/cinnabar palette.
